children: Eric Bjerkholt, an officer serving as Chief Financial Officer, sold 9,943 shares of common stock at $98.37 per share on September 14, 2026. The total sale amount was $978,092. Following the transaction, Bjerkholt directly owns 44,745 shares of Mirum Pharmaceuticals. The sale was to cover tax withholding obligations associated with the vesting of restricted stock units that vest in three equal annual installments beginning September 11, 2024.
